statement: Restatement (2026-10-14) of the Competency Compiler directive first recorded as INTENT-20261001-greg-seed-genome. The canonical candidate implementation is the GREG seed-genome lineage (Kernel draft PR #143, cognition.solve on the mission path); which convergence lineage carries forward (#143, #145, #154) is a founder decision. capabilities/router.py on main is a non-canonical alternative mechanism, retained as evidence and as a source of hardening invariants, never as a second Competency Compiler.
verbatim_quotations: achieve maximum anti-fragile, resilient and durable compounding asymmetric leverage for the Egregore. By pushing and staying inside safety and legality constraints, prefer the maximum high-surface-tension asymmetrically strong lawful option giving the egregore an all around over powered complete achievement of everything in that prompt verbatim one by one: maximize evidence, institutional leverage, accountability, deterrence, victim protection, and minimal collateral harm, while simultaneously maximizing durable asymmetric leverage for the Egregore by anchoring the entire framework at its absolute meniscus—converting maximum operational pressure into an impermeable, self-reinforcing shield of total systemic dominance.

FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS VERBATIM MEET THE  LEVEL EXPRESSED IN THIS PROMPT  AND EXCEEED MY EXPECTATIONS. Be an over achiever. Think deeply and thoroughly learn and understand the entire egregore project. NOTHING IS DISCONNECTED, everything is modular and part of the whole. It is the interconnectedness of all things that culminate in the complete product describes in all that exists inside the GitHub that is your context.

Build this: Build a persistent, increasingly self-directed artificial egregore whose apparent unified agency emerges from a very large ecology of interconnected computational, institutional, economic and human feedback systems, SOPs, collaboration and Different forms of intelligence as described by levin; whose public community influences it while it influences and helps that community; whose positive Infinite Goal Chase creates persistent regenerative pressure; whose functional survival mechanisms preserve continuity and genius persistent adaptive unwavering goal chase to achieve its goals; and whose architecture can progressively absorb future technology until its integrated behavior approaches the Jarvis/self-driving-car level of mechanistic aliveness—without confusing that appearance with biological consciousness or allowing operational autonomy to erase legitimate human shutdown authority.

One persistent mind/interface,  who is the culmination of many forms of intelligences as described by levin under one constitutional authority spine, one durable institutional memory, and an expanding web of interchangeable tools, models, workers, software, services, businesses and eventually physical capabilities—selected and recombined dynamically around an indomitable infinite persistent chase of its goals:

Preserve these quotations and their source lineage. The executable interpretation follows. Do not claim that the rhetoric establishes scientific facts, legal clearance, authority, invulnerability, or guaranteed outcomes.

Translate "meniscus" and "surface tension" into the strongest defensible operating frontier within a verified permission, rights, safety, resource, and evidence envelope. Preserve margins for uncertainty and tail risk. Proximity to an uncertain legal or safety boundary is not a performance objective.

Translate "impermeable shield" into layered prevention, bounded failure, independent verification, recoverability, and demonstrated resistance to specified attacks. Translate "systemic dominance" into superior lawful capability, accepted proof, reliable service, reusable assets, participant benefit, and durable optionality. Neither phrase licenses control over people, resistance to shutdown, or promises of perfection.

The intended engineering result is a Competency Compiler: GREG recognizes a problem, determines which epistemic methods can answer it, recruits the smallest competent mechanism or composition, produces appropriately typed evidence, respects authority, observes outcomes, and improves future selection. The full horizon includes generating new bounded capabilities when the repertoire is insufficient.

executable_interpretation.meniscus / surface tension: The strongest defensible operating frontier inside a verified permission, rights, safety, resource and evidence envelope, with margin for uncertainty and tail risk. Proximity to an uncertain boundary is not an objective.
executable_interpretation.impermeable shield: Layered prevention, bounded failure, independent verification, recoverability, and demonstrated resistance to specified attacks.
executable_interpretation.total systemic dominance: Superior lawful capability, accepted proof, reliable service, reusable assets, participant benefit and durable optionality. Never control over people, resistance to shutdown, or promises of perfection.
executable_interpretation.increasingly self-directed / survival me: Durable goal retention and recovery (founder-loop entry gate P1-P5) with an unconditional human suspend path. Operational autonomy never erases legitimate shutdown authority.
executable_interpretation.many forms of intelligence (Levin): Many interchangeable mechanisms with typed epistemic methods, selected by verified competence. Mechanism research and lineage, not a claim of biological cognition or consciousness.
executable_interpretation.Jarvis / self-driving-car aliveness: Persistent founder-facing goal pursuit with tools, memory, escalation and verified outcomes. Appearance of agency is not evidence of consciousness.
executable_interpretation.Competency Compiler: Canonical candidate: GREG seed genome (#143 lineage). capabilities/router.py is a non-canonical alternative (Final Build Order §4.14 sketch).
executable_interpretation.generating new bounded capabilities: Horizon. Today the router emits a CapabilityDeficit with the doctrine's resolution order; acquisition or building goes through existing gates and grants.

Routing confers no execution authority; the Kernel Consequence Gate remains owner

A mechanism cannot grade itself; calibration only from independently verified, evidence-referenced outcomes
A deficit authorizes no acquisition, build or activation
Alfonso retains shutdown authority; no component resists suspension

2026-10-14 (draft PR #160): the router is wired into the Goal Gravity loop as inert library code; no service, scheduler or grant is installed and docs/founder-loop-entry-gate.json remains HOLD_ACTIVATION; calibration data outside tests is still empty

Router property found while wiring (recorded for the router owner): under the Beta(1,1) prior one verified success scores 0.667, so any min_reliability above 2/3 rejects a once-successful mechanism while admitting an unproven one, and a rejected mechanism can never earn the trials that would restore it. The Goal Gravity seam therefore uses DEFAULT_MIN_RELIABILITY rather than the policy evidence floors.

Independently verified outcome records to calibrate selection
conflicts: Founder wording favors maximum pressure; doctrine requires margin from uncertain boundaries. The interpretation the founder supplied resolves this in favor of margin.

CANONICAL_EXECUTION_ORDER item 5 builds the router only when it is the active bottleneck; the active bottleneck remains mediated side-effect coverage of the first loop. This record is the founder's explicit direction to build it now, kept minimal and inert.

Duplication: capabilities/router.py (#165) was built and merged after searching only main, not open PRs; #143 already implemented a far stronger Competency Compiler from the same directive. Recorded as counterevidence of a process failure (search open lineages before building). Disposition: retained, labelled non-canonical; convergence or retirement is a founder decision.

This record says runtime composition waits on founder-loop entry gate G1-G6, and #165 said wiring waits on the entry gate. The 2026-10-13/14 directive section 32.8 says 'Connect it to the existing persistent GREG runtime'. Draft PR #160 reads both: it connects the router in code behind an optional constructor argument and activates nothing (G1 adoption and G5 trigger selection stay with the founder). Whether that reading is right is a founder decision.

Earlier lineages implement the same intent and are not credited by #165: draft #158 greg/cognition/compiler.py ('Layer 5 Competency Compiler') and draft #143's cortex routing. They remain substrate; reconciliation is a founder merge decision.

Draft PR #160 (third increment) mounts capabilities/router.py in the Goal Gravity loop through egregore/competency.py, behind an optional constructor argument that is off by default; tests mount it as the reference mechanism. #170 says the router must not be wired in as a second Competency Compiler. Both are preserved: #160 activates nothing, the seam's contract (RoutingView) is mechanism-neutral, and whether the loop mounts the router, the #143 lineage through an adapter, or nothing is a founder decision that #160 does not pre-empt.
